title: Independent review flow
description: Objective: implement reviewer eligibility/calibration, clean review packages, structured findings, rejection lineage, escalation, and acceptance qualification. Deliverable: packages/review application/core modules. NOT in scope: reviewer edits, self-review, transcript exposure, or waiving missing evidence. Hard dependencies: Planning graph lifecycle core, Policy approval core, Projection outbox core, Evidence receipt pipeline, and Deterministic context journal. Owned paths: packages/review/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/review typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/review test.
definitionOfDone: Authors and prior mutating lease holders cannot satisfy independent review; ineligible capacity yields UNKNOWN_REVIEWER_INDEPENDENCE.
The clean package excludes worker transcripts, self-assessment, and journal while binding exact criteria, hashes, tree, receipts, rubric, and submitted bytes.
Failed or unknown proof cannot accept; repeat findings route to replan and three unsuccessful rounds require human escalation.
The focused review typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
